name: Gilt market
summary: 10-year gilt near 5.2% as the Bank of England is expected to raise rates on 5 Nov
state: The 10-year gilt yield fell below 5.3% on 2 Nov, a six-week low, and was back above 5.2% on 3 Nov, below its mid-October level near 5.4%, a multi-year high (Trading Economics). Markets expect the Bank of England to raise Bank Rate to 4% on 5 Nov, its first rise since 2023 (Yahoo Finance). Auctions have been orderly as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Gilt yields feed into fixed mortgage rates and annuity pricing. Borrowers remortgaging soon are most exposed to rate moves.
rubric_hit: Gilt yields near multi-year highs = Watch; 10y moved < 40bp in a month, no BoE intervention

sources.title: Trading Economics — UK 10-year gilt yield news
Yahoo Finance — Bank of England poised to raise rates but may push back on bets for more

why: Gilt yields set UK mortgage rates and the government's borrowing costs; the 2022 LDI crisis showed how fast it can break.
drivers: Fiscal credibility, BoE policy, inflation, global bond moves, pension-fund flows.

rubric.alert: BoE intervention, or 10y moved > 75bp in a month.
rubric.watch: 30y gilt at multi-decade highs, or 10y moved 40–75bp in a month, or a weak auction.
rubric.normal: 10y gilt moved < 40bp in a month and auctions orderly.
